# Load the saved data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(scales)

df_urban_model <- readRDS("D:/Final-Project/model/data2/df_urban_model.rds")
obj <- readRDS("D:/Final-Project/outputs/combined_kriging_objects.rds")

df_urban_model <- st_drop_geometry(df_urban_model)

final_sf   <- obj$final_sf
schools_sf <- obj$dat_irl$schools_agg_sf
```

#comparison table

```{r}
compare_df <- df_urban_model %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(krig_value_per_100_3_18),
    is.finite(access_walk_per_100),
    is.finite(pop_3_18)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rank_krig     = rank(krig_value_per_100_3_18),
    rank_walk     = rank(access_walk_per_100),
    rank_diff     = rank_krig - rank_walk,
    abs_rank_diff = abs(rank_diff)
  )

cat("Number of CSAs:", nrow(compare_df), "\n")
```

#Scatter plot

The walking axis is on a log10 scale and capped at the 99th percentile for readability.

```{r}
# Scatter plot (both axes log10) with a line of equality

ggplot(compare_df,
       aes(x = krig_value_per_100_3_18,
           y = access_walk_per_100,
           colour = rank_diff)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_number(big.mark = ",")) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_number(big.mark = ",")) +
  scale_colour_gradient2(
    name = "Kriging - walk\nrank difference",
    low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey85", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Kriged school-place density",
    y = "Walking accessibility in 30 min",
    title = "Kriging vs travel-time accessibility, urban CSAs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

#divergent CSAs

```{r}
divergent <- compare_df %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_rank_diff)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  select(SA_PUB2022, krig_value_per_100_3_18, access_walk_per_100,
         rank_krig, rank_walk, rank_diff, pop_3_18)

divergent

cat("fewer than 20 children:",
    sum(divergent$pop_3_18 < 20), "\n")
```

#divergent CSAs

```{r}
divergent_sf <- final_sf %>%
  filter(SA_PUB2022 %in% divergent$SA_PUB2022) %>%
  left_join(divergent, by = "SA_PUB2022") %>%
  st_transform(4326)

schools_ll <- st_transform(schools_sf, 4326)
schools_in <- schools_ll[divergent_sf, ]

pal <- colorNumeric("RdBu", domain = divergent_sf$rank_diff)

# bounding box so the map opens zoomed to the data, not the whole island
bb_div <- st_bbox(divergent_sf)

leaflet(divergent_sf) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(rank_diff),
    fillOpacity = 0.6, weight = 1, color = "grey30",
    label = ~paste0("CSA ", SA_PUB2022)
  ) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = schools_in,
    radius = 3, color = "black", fillColor = "yellow",
    fillOpacity = 0.9, stroke = TRUE, weight = 1
  ) %>%
  addLegend(pal = pal, values = divergent_sf$rank_diff,
            title = "Kriging - walk<br>rank difference") %>%
  fitBounds(bb_div[["xmin"]], bb_div[["ymin"]],
            bb_div[["xmax"]], bb_div[["ymax"]])
```

#Map of the raw-value hotspots
.

```{r}
hotspot_sf <- final_sf %>%

leaflet(hotspot_sf) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%

    data = schools_hot,
    radius = 4, color = "black", fillColor = "yellow",
    fillOpacity = 0.9, stroke = TRUE, weight = 1

```

```{r}
# Marginal distributions of the two measures, and of their difference
# Neil asked for the distribution of each measure and of the differences.

# 1. Kriging distribution (log10 x-axis, matches the scatter)
ggplot(compare_df, aes(x = krig_value_per_100_3_18)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#2166AC", colour = "white") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_number(big.mark = ",")) +
  labs(x = "Kriged school-place density (per 100 children, log scale)",
       y = "Number of CSAs",
       title = "Distribution of kriging accessibility") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

# 2. Walking travel-time distribution (log10 x-axis)
ggplot(compare_df, aes(x = access_walk_per_100)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#B2182B", colour = "white") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_number(big.mark = ",")) +
  labs(x = "Walking accessibility in 30 min (per 100 children, log scale)",
       y = "Number of CSAs",
       title = "Distribution of travel-time accessibility") +

```

```{r}

# 3. Distribution of the difference in ranks between the two measures
ggplot(compare_df, aes(x = rank_diff)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "grey40", colour = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +
  labs(x = "Rank difference (kriging rank - walking rank)",
       y = "Number of CSAs",
       title = "Distribution of the rank difference between measures") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}

krig_mid <- median(compare_df$krig_value_per_100_3_18, na.rm = TRUE)

severance <- compare_df %>%
  filter(access_walk_per_100 == 0,
         krig_value_per_100_3_18 >= krig_mid) %>%
  arrange(desc(krig_value_per_100_3_18))

cat("CSAs with zero walking access overall:",
    sum(compare_df$access_walk_per_100 == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Of those, with kriging above the median:", nrow(severance), "\n\n")

# Table - the strongest severance examples (highest kriging, zero walking)
severance %>%
  select(SA_PUB2022, krig_value_per_100_3_18, access_walk_per_100,
         rank_krig, rank_walk, rank_diff, pop_3_18) %>%
  head(15)

# zero values can't sit on a log axis, so give them a tiny floor just for
# plotting, and draw a dotted line to show where the real zeros are.
plot_df <- compare_df %>%
  mutate(walk_plot = ifelse(access_walk_per_100 == 0, 1, access_walk_per_100))

sev_plot <- severance %>%
  mutate(walk_plot = 1)

ggplot(plot_df,
       aes(x = krig_value_per_100_3_18, y = walk_plot)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = rank_diff), alpha = 0.45) +
  geom_point(data = sev_plot,
             shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 0.8,
             colour = "black", fill = NA) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey40") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_number(big.mark = ",")) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_number(big.mark = ",")) +
  scale_colour_gradient2(
    name = "Kriging - walk\nrank difference",
    low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey85", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Kriged school-place density (per 100 children, log scale)",
    y = "Walking accessibility in 30 min (per 100 children, log scale)",
    title = "Schools nearby but none walkable: zero-walk CSAs circled",
    subtitle = "Dotted line for walking accessibility of zero"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Severance map zero-walk CSAs with nearby schools overlaid 
# whether schools sit just across a barrier (motorway, river, water).
# We take the strongest zero-walk CSAs
# school within the buffer on a street basemap, with enrolment

library(leaflet)

# pick a few of the strongest severance CSAs from the table
focus_ids <- c("237004007", "047132052", "047132051", "048051014")

# the chosen CSA polygons
focus_sf <- final_sf %>%
  filter(SA_PUB2022 %in% focus_ids) %>%
  st_transform(4326)

# buffer ~2 km around them, to catch nearby schools just outside the CSA
# (buffer in metres, so transform to a projected CRS first)
focus_buf <- focus_sf %>%
  st_transform(2157) %>%        # Irish Transverse Mercator (metres)
  st_buffer(2000) %>%
  st_transform(4326)

# all schools, then keep only those inside the buffer
schools_ll   <- st_transform(schools_sf, 4326)
schools_near <- schools_ll[focus_buf, ]

cat("Schools shown near these CSAs:", nrow(schools_near), "\n")

# OpenStreetMap basemap shows roads and rivers, so the barrier is visible
leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap) %>%
  addPolygons(
    data = focus_sf,
    fillColor = "red", fillOpacity = 0.4,
    weight = 2, color = "darkred",
    label = ~paste0("CSA ", SA_PUB2022)
  ) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = schools_near,
    radius = 4, color = "black", fillColor = "yellow",
    fillOpacity = 0.9, stroke = TRUE, weight = 1,
    label = ~paste0("School - enrolment: ", enrolment_total)
  )
```
